ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِاَصۡحٰبِ الۡفِيۡلِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel
ayahs.en: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?

ayahs.tl: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel
ayahs.en: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
And He sent against them birds in flocks,

ayahs.tl: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel
ayahs.en: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
And He made them like eaten straw.
